title: Administrator
description: Users and security, objects and Lightning App Builder, Sales and Service apps, data, reports and Flow automation.

sections.title: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder

questions.prompt: Support agents must only be able to log in from the office network. What should the administrator configure?

options.text: Trusted IP ranges under Network Access
Login IP ranges on the agents' profile
A sharing rule restricted by IP

questions.explanation: Login IP ranges on a profile block logins from anywhere else. Trusted IP ranges under Network Access only skip the identity-verification challenge; users outside them can still log in after verifying.

questions.prompt: Which setting defines the most restrictive baseline access users have to records they don't own?
questions.explanation: Organization-wide defaults set the baseline. Roles, sharing rules and manual sharing can only open access up from there, never restrict it below the default.

questions.prompt: One sales rep needs to delete Leads for a two-week project. Other users on the same profile must not get this permission. What is the best approach?

options.text: Clone the profile and grant Delete
Assign a permission set with Delete on Lead, with an expiration date
Give the rep the System Administrator profile
Create a sharing rule granting Full Access

questions.explanation: Permission sets add permissions to individual users without changing their profile, and a permission set assignment can carry an expiration date. Sharing rules grant record access, not object permissions like Delete.

questions.prompt: A user who left the company is the default owner of web-to-lead leads, so they can't be deactivated right away. How do you stop them logging in immediately?

options.text: Change their profile to Read Only

questions.explanation: Freezing a user blocks login at once while you reassign the settings (default lead owner, workflow recipients) that prevent deactivation. A password reset still lets someone with access to their email log in.

questions.prompt: Where does an administrator see how many user licenses are used and set the org's default time zone and currency locale?
questions.explanation: Company Information holds the org-wide defaults (locale, time zone, currency) and lists licenses with how many are used and remaining.

questions.prompt: Regional managers should be able to reset passwords and unlock users in their own region only, without any other admin rights. What should you use?

options.text: The Manage Users permission on their profile

questions.explanation: Delegated administration lets chosen users manage users in specified roles (and their subordinates). The Manage Users permission would apply to every user in the org.

questions.prompt: Finance must see every Opportunity over $1M, whoever owns it. Opportunity is Private. What should the administrator create?

options.text: A criteria-based sharing rule on Amount

questions.explanation: Criteria-based sharing rules share records by field values, such as Amount greater than 1,000,000, with a group or role. Owner-based rules share by who owns the record.

questions.prompt: A Project object needs a roll-up summary field that totals its Expense records. What must be true?

options.text: Expense has a lookup to Project
Expense has a master-detail relationship to Project
Project has a lookup to Expense

questions.explanation: Roll-up summary fields are created on the master side of a master-detail relationship. A lookup relationship needs a flow or Apex to total child records.

questions.prompt: What must be true before a lookup field can be converted to master-detail?

options.text: Every existing record has a value in the lookup field
The object has fewer than two master-detail fields and no record types

questions.explanation: Detail records can't exist without a master, so every existing record must already have a value in the lookup before the conversion is allowed.

questions.prompt: What do record types control? Choose 2.

options.text: Which page layout a profile sees
Which users can see a record

questions.explanation: A record type limits picklist values, and page layout assignment is done per profile and record type. Visibility comes from sharing, and field access comes from field-level security.

questions.prompt: A Salary field must be hidden from support users everywhere: page layouts, list views, reports and the API. What should you use?

options.text: Remove it from their page layout
Field-level security on their profile or permission sets
A record type without the field

questions.explanation: Field-level security applies everywhere, including reports, search, list views and the API. Removing a field from a page layout only hides it on that layout.

questions.prompt: On an Opportunity record page, a warning component should show only when Amount is over $1M. How?

options.text: Add a component visibility filter in Lightning App Builder

questions.explanation: Lightning App Builder components (and Dynamic Forms fields) can have visibility filters based on record fields, the user, device and more.

questions.prompt: Contact needs to show its Account's Industry without storing a copy that can go stale. Which field type?

options.text: Text field updated by a flow

questions.explanation: A formula can reference parent fields (Account.Industry) and is calculated when read, so it never goes stale. A copied text field must be kept in sync.

questions.prompt: A validation rule shows its error message when its formula evaluates to:
questions.explanation: A validation rule describes the invalid condition: when the formula is TRUE, the save is blocked and the error is shown.

questions.prompt: Students take many Courses and each Course has many Students. How is this modelled?

options.text: A lookup from Student to Course
A junction object with two master-detail relationships
A multi-select picklist of courses on Student

questions.explanation: Many-to-many relationships use a junction object (Enrollment) with a master-detail relationship to each side, so each enrollment links one student to one course.

questions.prompt: Which records can lead conversion create? Choose 3.
questions.explanation: Converting a lead creates (or merges into) an Account and a Contact and can optionally create an Opportunity. It never creates Cases or Campaigns.

questions.prompt: Leads from the website must go to a regional queue based on Country. What should be configured?
questions.explanation: Lead assignment rules route new leads (including web-to-lead) to users or queues based on criteria. Escalation rules are for Cases.

questions.prompt: Where is the default Probability of each Opportunity stage defined?
questions.explanation: Each Stage picklist value carries a default Probability and Forecast Category. Sales processes choose which stages each record type can use.

questions.prompt: Sales managers want reps to see key fields and guidance for each Opportunity stage at the top of the record. What should you set up?
questions.explanation: Path shows the stages across the top of the record with key fields and guidance for success for each step.

questions.prompt: Why can't a new product be added to a custom price book?

options.text: It has no standard price in the standard price book
It isn't marked as a Family

questions.explanation: A product needs a standard price in the standard price book before it can be given a list price in a custom price book.

questions.prompt: Marketing wants the results of several webinars rolled up under one annual event. What should they use?

options.text: A lookup from Lead to Campaign

questions.explanation: Campaign hierarchies group child campaigns under a parent, and the parent shows the aggregated statistics of its children.

questions.prompt: High-priority cases not closed within 8 hours must be reassigned to a supervisor. What should you use?
questions.explanation: Escalation rules act on cases that meet criteria for a period of time, reassigning and notifying. Assignment rules run only when the case is created or edited.

questions.prompt: Customers email support@company.com and each email should become a Case automatically. What should you enable?
questions.explanation: Email-to-Case turns incoming email to a routing address into Cases. Web-to-Case captures cases from a web form.

questions.prompt: Support must track whether first response happens within the time promised in each customer's contract. What should be used?
questions.explanation: Entitlements define the support a customer gets, and entitlement processes with milestones track required steps such as first response against a time limit.

questions.prompt: Cases should be pushed to the next available agent based on how much work each agent already has. What should you use?
questions.explanation: Omni-Channel routes work items to agents based on availability, capacity and skills. Queues alone wait for agents to pick work up.

questions.prompt: Hardware and Software cases need different lists of Status values. What do you set up?

options.text: Two support processes, each used by a Case record type

questions.explanation: Support processes choose which Case Status values are available, and each Case record type uses a support process.

questions.prompt: Users following an Account want a feed post whenever its Rating changes. What should you enable?

options.text: Feed tracking on the Rating field

questions.explanation: Feed tracking posts changes to tracked fields in the record's feed, which followers see. Field history tracking records changes in a related list, not the feed.

questions.prompt: Which activity records appear on a user's calendar?
questions.explanation: Events have a start and end time and appear on the calendar. Tasks are to-do items with a due date.

questions.prompt: Field reps want a one-tap action in the mobile app to log a visit on an Account. What should you configure?

options.text: An object-specific quick action added to the Account page layout

questions.explanation: Object-specific quick actions on the page layout's mobile and Lightning actions section show up in the Salesforce mobile app.

questions.prompt: You need to import 120,000 Contacts from a CSV file. Which tool?
questions.explanation: The Data Import Wizard handles up to 50,000 records. Data Loader handles up to 5 million and also supports delete and export.

questions.prompt: Which tool can delete 200,000 records listed in a CSV file?
questions.explanation: Data Loader can delete (and hard delete) records by Id. The Import Wizard can't delete, and Mass Delete Records works only on certain objects and in batches of 250.

questions.prompt: Users must be blocked from creating a Lead whose email matches an existing Lead. What should you configure? Choose 2.

options.text: A duplicate rule set to Block
A unique external Id field on Lead Email

questions.explanation: Matching rules decide what counts as a duplicate, and duplicate rules decide what happens (alert or block). VLOOKUP only works on custom objects.

questions.prompt: Managers need a report of Accounts, including Accounts with no Opportunities. What do you need?

options.text: A custom report type where Accounts may or may not have related Opportunities

questions.explanation: The standard Accounts with Opportunities report type only includes Accounts that have at least one. A custom report type can include records with or without related records.

questions.prompt: Which report format groups by both rows and columns?
questions.explanation: Matrix reports group by rows and columns, like a pivot table. Summary reports group by rows only.

questions.prompt: Each sales rep should see the dashboard with only the data they have access to. What should you set?

options.text: Running user: the dashboard viewer (dynamic dashboard)
A report filter of My Opportunities

questions.explanation: A dynamic dashboard runs as whoever views it, so each viewer sees data according to their own access.

questions.prompt: Leadership wants to see how the pipeline changed week by week. What captures the data over time?
questions.explanation: Reporting snapshots copy a source report's results into a custom object on a schedule, building a history for trend reporting.

questions.prompt: When an Opportunity is saved, a field on the same record must be set as fast as possible. Which flow?

options.text: Record-triggered flow optimized for Fast Field Updates (before save)
Record-triggered flow optimized for Actions and Related Records (after save)

questions.explanation: Before-save flows update the triggering record without an extra DML statement, so they're much faster than after-save flows for same-record updates.

questions.prompt: Discounts over 20% need a manager's approval, and the Opportunity must not be edited while it's pending. What should you use?
questions.explanation: Approval processes route records to approvers and lock the record while it's pending approval.

questions.prompt: Owners should get an email 3 days before an Opportunity's Close Date. What's the best approach?

options.text: A record-triggered flow with a scheduled path based on Close Date

questions.explanation: Scheduled paths run actions a set time before or after a date field on the record. Workflow rules are retired for new automation in favour of Flow.

questions.prompt: Agents need a guided, step-by-step wizard to collect warranty details and create a Case. What should you build?
questions.explanation: Screen flows show screens to users, collect input and can create or update records along the way.

questions.prompt: Salesforce recommends which tool for new declarative automation?
questions.explanation: Workflow Rules and Process Builder are retired for new automation. Flow is the recommended declarative tool, and Apex is for when declarative tools can't do the job.

questions.prompt: What does Salesforce require for every user who logs in to the user interface directly?
questions.explanation: Salesforce requires MFA for direct UI logins. SSO logins can satisfy it through the identity provider's own MFA. Login IP ranges are optional extra protection.

questions.prompt: Sales reps need the same five permission sets. What makes assigning and maintaining them easiest?

options.text: A permission set group containing the five permission sets

questions.explanation: Permission set groups bundle permission sets so users get them in one assignment, and a muting permission set can remove anything that shouldn't be included.

questions.prompt: The Sub-Category options should change depending on the chosen Category. What do you configure?

options.text: A dependent picklist with Category as the controlling field

questions.explanation: Dependent picklists show only the values allowed for the controlling field's current value.

questions.prompt: Managers want to report on what a discount percentage was at the time of each sale, even if the formula inputs change later. What's the problem with a formula field?

options.text: Formulas are calculated when read, so they always show today's value
Formulas are deleted after a year

questions.explanation: A formula has no stored history. To keep the value at a point in time, store it in a regular field (for example with a flow at the moment of sale).

questions.prompt: Users should only be able to pick active Accounts in the Partner lookup on Opportunity. What do you use?

options.text: A lookup filter on the Partner field

questions.explanation: Lookup filters restrict which records can be selected in a lookup, and can show an error or simply hide non-matching records.

questions.prompt: An ERP sends customer records with its own customer number. What should the matching field on Account be marked as, so imports can update the right record? Choose 2.
questions.explanation: An External ID field lets imports and integrations upsert by that value; making it unique stops two Accounts sharing a customer number.

questions.prompt: Several people work on large deals and need edit access to those Opportunities only. What should be used?
questions.explanation: Opportunity teams give specific people access to a specific opportunity, with a role and access level per member.

questions.prompt: Agents keep answering the same questions. What lets them search and attach approved answers to cases?
questions.explanation: Knowledge stores reviewed articles that agents can search from the case and share with customers.

questions.prompt: Customers submit support requests from a form on your website. What feature creates cases from it?
questions.explanation: Web-to-Case generates an HTML form that creates cases. Web-to-Lead does the same for leads.

questions.prompt: A list view should be visible only to the support team. How?

options.text: Share the list view with a public group or role

questions.explanation: List views can be shared with all users, or limited to selected public groups and roles.

questions.prompt: Which type of activity has a due date but no start and end time?
questions.explanation: Tasks are to-dos with a due date; events are calendar entries with start and end times.

questions.prompt: You import a file where some rows are new contacts and some update existing ones, matched on an External ID. Which operation?
questions.explanation: Upsert inserts rows with no match and updates rows whose External ID (or Salesforce Id) matches.

questions.prompt: How long are deleted records kept in the Recycle Bin before being permanently removed?
questions.explanation: Deleted records stay in the Recycle Bin for 15 days, subject to storage-based limits, before they're permanently deleted.

questions.prompt: Which feature produces a scheduled weekly backup of your org's data as CSV files?
questions.explanation: The Data Export Service (Setup > Data Export) can export all data weekly or monthly as CSV files.

questions.prompt: A record-triggered flow should act only when Stage changes to Closed Won, not on every edit of a Closed Won record. Which setting?

options.text: Run every time a record is updated and meets the conditions
Only when a record is updated to meet the condition requirements

questions.explanation: 'Only when a record is updated to meet the condition requirements' compares with the prior values, so it fires once on the change.

questions.prompt: A flow's Update Records element fails for some users. How do you show them a helpful message instead of an unhandled error?

options.text: Add a fault path from the element
Run the flow in system context

questions.explanation: Fault paths run when an element fails, so you can show a message, log the error or notify an admin.

questions.prompt: Three flows contain the same steps to create a follow-up task. How do you avoid maintaining three copies?

options.text: Put the steps in one flow and call it as a subflow

questions.explanation: Subflows let one flow call another, so shared logic lives in one place.

questions.prompt: A flow should email the opportunity owner using an existing template with merge fields. Which element or action?

options.text: Send Email Alert action (using an email alert)

questions.explanation: Email alerts use email templates and recipients you configure; flows can call them as actions.

questions.prompt: Two record-triggered flows run on the same object and event. How do you control which runs first?

options.text: Set the Trigger Order value on each flow

questions.explanation: Record-triggered flows have a Trigger Order setting that decides their relative order for the same object and timing.
